text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan once appeared on national 
television. Because of that, all eyes seem 
to be on her right from her debut race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, she does not feel pressured by 
the spotlight. Without looking back... she 
heads toward the race, all on her own.
